paired-before-after.alt: Left: a slope chart of resting heart rate for 12 gym members, before and after a breathing class, on a scale from 60 to 90 beats per minute; 11 lines slope down and one slopes up. Right: a dotplot of the 12 differences, before minus after: -1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 5, 5, 5, 6, with mean 2.83 and standard deviation 2.12. All but one difference is above 0.
